title: Gobbledigook
annotation:
There are two variants of spelling for this track: "Gobbeldigook" and "Gobbledigook".

Jonsi, who wrote all the song titles for the artwork, originally spelt it "Gobbeldigook" instead of "Gobbledigook" (as it should be). It was then Photoshopped to the correct spelling for the US version and the UK/EMI promo.

However, when EMI were doing the artwork for the normal CD, they were given the original version ("Gobbeldigook") and nobody noticed until it was too late. They could have re-printed them, but that's not very eco-friendly and it wasn't a big issue, so it was left. ([http://www.sigur-ros.co.uk/board/viewthread.php?tid=26130|source])

Note: Appears to be 2 different versions here the single version and the album version (distinct despite similar times) see: http://musicbrainz.org/edit/30181890

Per an edit note, lifted from Wikipedia:
"In the album version, Gaye and (Gordon) Banks' background vocals immediately come after the second bridge ends, but in the single version, Gaye repeats the vamp he had sung at the ending of the first bridge, this time with (Harvey) Fuqua's whispers added. The song ends with Gaye repeating the chorus line. As it fades out, Gaye can be heard singing, "please don't procrastinate, it's not good to masturbate."
